third_expert_blend.proof: For baseline b=(DINO+ConvNeXt)/2, blend=0.8b+0.2j. The best possible j assigns 1 to the true class and 0 elsewhere. A baseline error is fixable only when max_other(b)-b_true<=0.25. Count ties within 1e-12 as potentially fixable and grant that every remaining baseline-correct image stays correct. Add these optimistic counts to the already-observed blend correct predictions.

conclusion: Further requests cannot make the frozen blend or direct final Jev meet the accuracy gate; the completed router also fails.
interpretation: Upper bounds are mathematical best cases for unobserved responses, not measured full-development scores. Observed subset scores cover completed rows only. The original development split was reused for earlier model selection; no unbiased test-set score is claimed.
